tools.name: get_page_context
tools.description: Returns the title, meta description, language, and canonical URL of the currently displayed page. Useful for understanding where the user is before deciding which navigation or action tool to invoke.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigates the browser to a page on the IRIS Corporate site. Use this to send the user to products, solutions, industry verticals, resources, partner information, or company pages. Provide the path as a relative URL (e.g. "/products", "/solutions", "/contact").

path.description: Relative path to navigate to, e.g. "/products/cloud" or "/resources/academy".

tools.name: open_contact_sales
tools.description: Opens the IRIS Corporate Contact Sales form so the user can submit an inquiry to the sales team. Use this when the user expresses intent to purchase, request a demo, ask for pricing, or speak with a sales representative.
